name: Clemens Food Group
old_description: Six generations ago, we were founded in Hatfield, Pennsylvania. Although we’ve grown since then, our promise has not changed. For more than 130 years, we’ve been conducting business in a way that’s good for our customers, respectful to our employees and compassionate toward animals.
about:
Clemens Food Group was founded in Hatfield, Pennsylvania, six generations ago and has operated continuously for more than 130 years. The business remains a sixth-generation, family-owned enterprise, rooted in the small independent farms that formed its early legacy. While the names of the original founders are not publicly disclosed, the company’s history traces back to a commitment to ethical animal husbandry and community-focused commerce.

Today the company operates a fully vertically coordinated pork supply chain. Its network includes a feed mill that formulates diets for sow, nursery, and finishing farms; a farming division, Country View Family Farms, comprising over 250 company-owned and independent family farms across Indiana, Michigan, Ohio, and Pennsylvania; three pork processing facilities in Hatfield and Tyrone, Pennsylvania, and Coldwater, Michigan; and a dedicated logistics and transportation fleet that moves live hogs and finished products to customers. This integration allows the company to control every step from feed to delivery.

Clemens Food Group serves foodservice distributors, retail grocers, and food manufacturers through a portfolio of brands that includes Hatfield®, Kunzler®, Farm Promise®, and Prima Porta® by Hatfield® dinner sausage. The company emphasizes flexible, responsive service for customers of all sizes, from independent restaurants to national chains, leveraging its integrated system to ensure consistent quality and supply reliability.

The company’s differentiation rests on its ownership of the entire production process, a model it describes as "vertically and purposefully coordinated." Leadership cites core values of Ethics, Integrity, and Stewardship as the foundation for decisions, and the Farm Promise® brand markets a No Antibiotics Ever, sustainably raised pork program. This approach, they say, builds a responsive, flexible system that benefits the community, the environment, and the end consumer.
